decisions.reason: These plug-ins extend the firm's core geospatial component business as a modular product line, so they are relatively cheap to maintain and still have good option value.

The building data digital twin service fits the firm's strategic direction but is more sales- and delivery-intensive, so it should be kept while accepting a meaningful risk of later exit if traction stays limited.
After two years and alongside the more GIS-specific identity offering, this generic authentication and delegation service appears redundant enough that its standalone option value is now limited.
The open GIS application development framework strengthens the firm's platform and ecosystem position and can generate complementary project work, which argues for keeping it on the market.
This GIS-focused identity and access service remains closely aligned with enterprise integration needs and looks like the stronger identity-related option to retain.
The geodata business process consulting workshop is very new and inexpensive to offer as a consulting format, so the firm would normally keep it available until demand becomes clearer.
